title: A squarefree annihilator gives invariant complements
statement: Let $K$ be a field, let $V$ be a $K$-vector space, and let $T:V\to V$ be $K$-linear. Let $p\in K[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be squarefree, meaning nonzero and divisible by no square of a nonconstant polynomial, and assume $p(T)=0$. Then every $T$-invariant subspace $W\subseteq V$ has a $T$-invariant complement: there exists $W\prime\subseteq V$ with $T(W\prime)\subseteq W\prime$ and $V=W\oplus W\prime$.
